DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 車の傷についてのご相談ですね。接触はいつありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to discuss a scratch on your car. When did the contact happen?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今日の昼、駐車場で別の車と接触しました。その場では傷が見えず、帰宅してから見つけました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 接触後に帰宅して傷を見つけた経緯を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: At noon today, I had contact with another car in a parking lot. I could not see a scratch there and found it after getting home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain how you found the scratch at home after the contact. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その傷が今日の接触でできたかは、その場で確認できていないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: So you did not confirm at the scene whether today's contact caused that scratch.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。前からあった傷かもしれません。今日できたと断定したくありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 傷が今回できたとは断定できないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: That's right. It may have been there before. I do not want to state that it happened today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you cannot be certain this incident caused the scratch. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 当時の場所、相手と交わした連絡先、その後に撮った写真はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you have the location, the contact details you exchanged, and photographs taken afterward?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 場所と連絡先はあります。写真は帰宅後に撮ったものだけです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 持っている連絡先と写真の撮影時点を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have the location and contact details. The only photos I have were taken after I got home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain what contact information you have and when the photographs were taken. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 撮影した時刻が分かる形で残してください。当時の写真として扱わず、後で気付いた傷として伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Keep them in a form that shows when they were taken. We will take your account as a scratch noticed later, rather than treating them as photographs from the scene.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 相手にも、帰宅後に傷を見つけたが原因は確認中だと伝えてよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 相手に伝える事実と未確認事項を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: May I also tell the other person that I found a scratch after getting home but am still checking its cause?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask about the facts and unconfirmed points to tell the other person. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確かめていないことを断定せず、事実と確認中の点を分けて伝えてください。詳しい手続きは担当者から案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Do not state unverified things as facts. Explain the facts separately from what is still being checked. The person in charge will explain the detailed procedure.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。接触の時刻と場所、帰宅後に気付いた時刻を分けて説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 接触時刻と発見時刻を分けて整理する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will explain separately the time and place of the contact and the time I noticed the scratch after getting home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Organize the time of contact separately from the time of discovery. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、経緯と資料を担当者へ引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will pass your account and materials on to the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらは機器の返送ですか。返却先から指定された送り方はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you returning this equipment? Has the recipient specified a shipping method?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 借りていた機器です。会社の住所を調べて書きましたが、箱の中に返却用ラベルも入っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 借りた機器の返送だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is equipment I borrowed. I looked up and wrote the company's address, but there was also a return label inside the box.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you are returning borrowed equipment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: そのラベルと、いま書いた住所は同じですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Does that label show the same address as the one you just wrote?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 違います。ラベルには返却センターと書いてあります。会社の本社へ送るつもりでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自分で書いた住所と返却ラベルが違うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: No. The label says return center. I was planning to send it to the company's head office.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that the address you wrote differs from the return label. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 返却先の指定を確認しましょう。ラベルに利用する配送方法の記載もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check the specified return destination. Does the label also state which delivery method to use?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありますが、この窓口で使えるか分かりません。自分で送料を払えばよいと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 指定ラベルをこの窓口で使えるか質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, but I do not know whether I can use it at this counter. I thought I just needed to pay the postage myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether the specified label can be used at this counter. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 指定されたサービスか確認してから受付可否をご案内します。違う方法で送る前に、貸出元の説明も確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check whether this is the specified service before telling you whether we can accept it. Check the lender's instructions too before using a different method.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。本社の住所を使わず、返却ラベルと案内を照合します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 貸出元の案内と返却先を照合すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I will compare the return label with the instructions instead of using the head office address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will compare the lender's instructions and return destination. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 箱には別の住所ラベルが残らないようにしてください。指定先が確認できるまではお預かりしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Make sure no other address label remains on the box. We cannot take it until the specified destination is confirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。二つの送り先が見える状態で出さず、指定された返却先を確認して戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 送り先の表示を一つにしてから持ち込むと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will not submit it with two destinations visible. I will check the specified return destination and come back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will bring it in after leaving only one destination displayed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらの案内の配送方法欄をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please check the delivery method section of these instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 紙幣が戻ってきていますね。入金の操作は止められていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: The banknote is being returned. Have you stopped the deposit operation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。この一枚だけ何度も戻ります。強く押し込めば入るかと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 紙幣が何度も戻る状態を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. This one note keeps coming back. I thought pushing it in harder might work.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the banknote keeps being returned. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 無理に押し込まないでください。紙幣と、画面に出た内容を確認させてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do not force it in. Please let me check the note and what appeared on the screen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 角が折れています。ほかの紙幣は入りましたが、この一枚は手元にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 折れた紙幣と画面表示を係員に確認してもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Its corner is folded. The other notes went in, but I still have this one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Have the attendant check the folded banknote and screen display. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 画面の入金額には、この戻った紙幣の金額が含まれていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Does the deposit amount on the screen include the value of this returned note?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 画面は九千円です。手元の千円を足して一万円入れたいのですが、まだ確定していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未確定の九千円と手元の千円を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: The screen shows 9,000 yen. I want to add the 1,000 yen in my hand to deposit 10,000 yen, but I have not confirmed it yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish the unconfirmed 9,000 yen from the 1,000 yen you still hold. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では、確定前の金額と手元の紙幣を分けて確認しましょう。窓口で扱えるか担当者に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's check the unconfirmed amount separately from the note in your hand. I will ask the person in charge whether the counter can handle it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 先に九千円だけ確定すると、残りとは別の入金になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 別々の入金になるか質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: If I confirm just the 9,000 yen first, will the remainder be a separate deposit?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whether they would become separate deposits. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 操作の状態を確認してご案内します。ここで追加操作をせず、そのままお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will check the operation's status and explain. Please wait here without making any further operations.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。九千円は画面上で未確定、千円は手元に残っていると伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 追加操作をせず担当者を待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will explain that the 9,000 yen on screen is unconfirmed and I still have the 1,000 yen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will wait for the person in charge without further operations. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当者を呼びますので、紙幣を手元に持ったままお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will call the person in charge. Please wait with the note in your hand.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの袋には計量ラベルが見当たりませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: I cannot see a weighing label on this bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 数字のシールを外してしまいました。袋の値段が棚に書いてあると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 計量ラベルを外してしまったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I removed the sticker with the numbers. I thought the shelf showed the price per bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you removed the weighing label. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この教材の商品は重さで価格が変わります。袋の中身は同じ種類だけですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: The price of the product in this learning material varies by weight. Does this bag contain just one kind?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。同じナッツだけです。外したシールはまだポケットにあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 袋の中身が同じ種類だけだと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. They are all the same nuts. I still have the removed sticker in my pocket.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that the bag contains only one kind. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、そのシールを見せてください。品名と袋の内容を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please show me that sticker. I will check the product name against the contents of the bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらです。重さと価格が書かれています。次から会計が終わるまで残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 外したラベルを提示し会計まで残すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here it is. It shows the weight and price. Next time I will keep it until payment is finished.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the removed label and say you will keep it until payment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 袋との対応が確認できなければ、売場で計量し直します。別の袋のシールは使えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: If we cannot confirm that it belongs to this bag, we will weigh it again in the sales area. A sticker from another bag cannot be used.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。この袋のものだと確認してもらい、必要なら計り直していただきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 袋とラベルの対応を確認してもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I will have you confirm that it belongs to this bag and reweigh it if necessary.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Have them confirm that the label corresponds to the bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 開封したり、中身を足したりはしていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Have you opened the bag or added anything to it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: していません。計量後はシールを外しただけで、量は変えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 計量後に中身を増減していないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: No. After weighing, I only removed the sticker; I have not changed the quantity.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you have not added or removed any contents since weighing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その状態も含めて売場担当者に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will check with the sales staff, including that condition.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: そちらの滑り台は、いま点検中です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: That slide is currently being inspected.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 札の数字を順番の番号だと思っていました。子どもを階段の前で待たせてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 点検札の番号を待ち順と誤解したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I thought the number on the sign was a queue number. May I have my child wait in front of the stairs?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you mistook the inspection sign's number for a queue number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 階段も含めて使えない範囲です。囲いの外へ移動をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: The unavailable area includes the stairs. Please move outside the barrier.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。子どもを呼んで、囲いの外のベンチへ行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 子どもを囲いの外へ移動させると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. I will call my child over and go to the bench outside the barrier.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will move your child outside the barrier. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。数字は点検の管理番号で、待ち順ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Thank you. The number is an inspection reference number, not a queue number.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 終わる時刻は書いてありませんね。番号を呼ばれるまで待つ仕組みではないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 番号の意味と再開時刻を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: There is no finishing time written. So this is not a system where we wait for our number to be called.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the meaning of the number and the reopening time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。再開時刻はまだご案内できません。ほかの遊具の利用状況を確認しましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Correct. We cannot give a reopening time yet. Shall we check the availability of other play equipment?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。子どもは小さいので、年齢に合うものを探したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 子どもの年齢に合う別の遊具を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, please. My child is young, so I would like to find something suitable for their age.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask about other play equipment suitable for your child's age. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 向こうの案内板に対象年齢と使用状況があります。付き添ってご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: The information board over there shows age ranges and availability. Please accompany your child and check it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。点検が終わると決めつけず、案内板を見て別の遊具を選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 案内板で対象年齢と使用状況を確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will not assume the inspection will finish; I will check the board and choose other play equipment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will check age ranges and availability on the information board. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 案内板はこちらです。お子さんと一緒にお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: The information board is this way. Please go with your child.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どちらの駅へ行く予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Which station are you planning to go to?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人の画像で青い線の端に丸があったので、ここが集合駅だと思いました。でも駅名が小さくて読めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 路線図の色だけで集合駅を判断したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: My friend's image had a circle at the end of a blue line, so I thought this was our meeting station. But the station name is too small to read.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you identified the meeting station only by the line map's color. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 画像を拡大しても、駅名は確認できませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Can you still not identify the station name when you enlarge the image?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。似た名前の駅が二つあります。色だけで判断して来てしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 画像では駅名を読み取れないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: That's right. There are two stations with similar names. I came here based on the color alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you cannot read the station name in the image. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 友人に駅名を文字で送ってもらいましょう。改札の内側か外側かも確認すると行き違いを減らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Ask your friend to send the station name in writing. Also checking whether you are meeting inside or outside the ticket gates can reduce misunderstandings.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: いま聞きます。返事には別の駅名と、東口の外と書いてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 友人に駅名と集合場所を文字で確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will ask now. Their reply gives a different station name and says outside the east exit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the station name and meeting place with your friend in writing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では、その駅までの経路を調べます。集合時刻は何時ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will look up the route to that station. What time are you meeting?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 十時です。間に合うか確認して、遅れる場合は先に連絡したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 集合時刻と遅れる場合の連絡意図を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: At ten. I want to check whether I can arrive on time and contact them in advance if I will be late.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: State the meeting time and your intention to contact them if late. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 次の電車と乗り換えでの到着見込みをご案内します。東口までの移動時間も見込んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will give you an estimated arrival using the next train and transfers. Please allow time to reach the east exit too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。文字で確認した駅名と東口を基準にし、到着見込みを友人に伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 正しい駅と出口への到着見込みを共有すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will use the station name and east exit confirmed in writing and tell my friend my estimated arrival.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will share your estimated arrival at the correct station and exit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらの経路をご覧ください。駅名を指で確かめながらご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please look at this route. I will explain while pointing out the station names.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この申請書には、ご本人とお父様のお名前がありますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: This application form has both your name and your father's name.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。家族なので一枚にまとめました。父は別の住所に住んでいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 別住所の父の分も一枚に書いたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I put us on one form because we are family. My father lives at a different address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you included your father, who lives elsewhere, on the same form. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 必要な証明書はそれぞれ何に使いますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: What will each of you use the required certificate for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私は勤務先に、父は自分の手続きに使います。父から取ってきてほしいと言われました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: それぞれの証明書の用途を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Mine is for my employer, and my father's is for his own procedure. He asked me to collect it for him.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State what each certificate will be used for. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 同じ家族でも、別世帯の方の分は申請資格や代理の確認が必要です。お父様の依頼が分かる書類はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Even within a family, applications for someone in a different household require checks of eligibility or representation. Do you have a document showing your father's request?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 口頭で頼まれただけです。私の身分証だけで両方取れると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 依頼が口頭だけであると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: He only asked me verbally. I thought I could get both with just my own identification.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that the request was only verbal. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: まずご本人の申請と、お父様の分の必要書類を分けて確認しましょう。今回必要な代理書類を担当者がご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's first check your application separately from the documents needed for your father's. The person in charge will explain the representative documents required this time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では、自分の分を先に進め、父の分は必要な書類を確認してから準備します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自分の申請を先に進め父の分の必要書類を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I will proceed with mine first and prepare my father's after checking the necessary documents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Proceed with your application first and check the documents required for your father's. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 対象者の欄も混ざっていますので、新しい用紙でご本人の分を書き直しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: The applicant details are mixed together too, so let's rewrite your application on a new form.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。父の名前を自分の申請に残さず、別の依頼として扱います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 対象者が混ざらないよう申請書を書き直すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will not leave my father's name on my application and will treat his as a separate request.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will rewrite the form so the people concerned are not mixed up. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらの用紙をお使いください。代理申請の案内も一緒にお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please use this form. I will also give you the guidance on applying as a representative.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 帰宅前の説明で、確認したいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything you would like to check in the instructions before going home?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この紙の時刻を自分の予定に合わせて書き直しました。でも変更してよい指示だったか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 注意書きの時刻を自分で変えたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I rewrote the time on this paper to suit my schedule. But I do not know whether it was an instruction I could change.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you changed the time on the written precautions yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの部分を書き直しましたか。元の記載はまだ読めますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which part did you rewrite? Can the original wording still be read?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 上から線を引いて午後三時と書きました。元は午後一時と読めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 元の時刻と書き換えた時刻を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I crossed it out and wrote 3 p.m. I can still read the original as 1 p.m.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the original time and the time you changed it to. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 自己判断で変更せず、処置を担当した者に確認します。いまはどちらの時刻でも実行しないでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do not change it on your own judgment. I will check with the person who performed the treatment. For now, please wait without carrying it out at either time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。勤務の都合で変えたかったのですが、可能かを先に聞くべきでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 勤務の都合で変更したかったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I wanted to change it because of work, but I should have asked first whether that was possible.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you wanted a change because of your work schedule. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 仕事の予定もお伝えください。調整できることと、守る必要があることを担当者から説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please tell us your work schedule too. The person in charge will explain what can be adjusted and what must be followed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 午後一時には移動中です。必要なら予定を変えるので、元の指示の意味を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 元の指示の意味と調整可否を質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will be traveling at 1 p.m. I will change my plans if necessary, so please explain what the original instruction means.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask what the original instruction means and whether adjustment is possible. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認後、読みやすい注意書きを用意します。書き込みのある紙は説明のために残してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: After checking, we will prepare clear written precautions. Keep the paper you wrote on so you can explain it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。書き込みを隠さず見せて、確認した指示を書いた紙を持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 書き込みを残して確認後の指示を持ち帰ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will show my writing without hiding it and take home a paper with the confirmed instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will keep the writing and take home the instructions after confirmation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当者に確認しますので、待合の席でお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will check with the person in charge. Please wait in the waiting area.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どのような音についてのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: What sort of noise would you like to discuss?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 夜に大きな音が続きました。録音はありますが、どの建物から出たのかは見ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 音の発生元を見ていないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: There was a loud noise continuing at night. I have a recording, but I did not see which building it came from.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you did not see the source of the noise. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 発生元が確認できていないということですね。聞こえた時刻と、ご自身の場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: So the source has not been confirmed. Please tell me when you heard it and where you were.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 昨夜十一時ごろ、自宅の窓際です。向かいの建物だと思いましたが、外へ出て確認はしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 聞こえた時刻と自分の位置を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Around eleven last night, by the window at home. I thought it was the building opposite, but I did not go outside to check.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain when you heard it and your own location. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 思った場所と、実際に確認した場所は分けて伺います。音はいまも聞こえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will distinguish the place you suspected from the place you actually confirmed. Can you still hear the noise now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: いまは聞こえません。録音には車の音も入っていて、気になった音と混ざっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 現在は音がなく録音に別の音も混ざると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Not now. The recording also contains traffic sounds mixed with the noise that bothered me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the noise is no longer audible and other sounds are mixed into the recording. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その点も記録します。録音のどの時間帯に気になった音があるか、分かる範囲で示してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will record that too. Please indicate, as far as you can, which part of the recording contains the noise that bothered you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 開始から一分ほどのところです。発生元の住所として向かいの建物を書かないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 気になった録音箇所を示し住所を断定しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: About one minute from the start. I will avoid writing the opposite building's address as the source.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Indicate the relevant recording section and say you will not assert the address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。時刻、聞こえた場所、音の特徴、確認できていない点を担当者にお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. I will tell the person in charge the time, where you heard it, its characteristics, and what has not been confirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。自分が聞いた事実だけを整理し、録音は元のまま持ってきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確認した事実と未確認事項を整理すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will organize only the facts I heard myself and bring the original, unchanged recording.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Organize confirmed facts and unconfirmed points. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その内容で相談を引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will pass on your inquiry with those details.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの封筒の宛先は、点字で表示されているのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: The address on this envelope is displayed in braille.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。友人が受け取って分かるようにしました。郵便の配達にも、この表示だけで足りますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人が触って読めるよう点字で宛先を書いたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I made it so my friend could read it upon receiving it. Is this display alone enough for postal delivery too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you wrote the address in braille so your friend could read it by touch. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 配達に使う住所と名前は、読める文字でも確認できるようにしてください。点字の表示を残すことはできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please make sure the delivery address and name can also be checked in readable print. You may leave the braille in place.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: では、点字を消すのではなく、空いている場所に文字の住所ラベルを貼りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 点字を残して文字の住所を追加したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then I would like to add a printed address label in an empty space instead of removing the braille.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you want to retain the braille and add a printed address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 点字に重ならず、宛先を読み取れる位置を確認しましょう。文字の宛先は手元にありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's find a readable position that does not overlap the braille. Do you have the address in print with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 友人が送ってくれた住所のメッセージがあります。番地と部屋番号を、その内容に合わせて書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 友人から届いた住所を番地と部屋番号まで照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have a message with the address my friend sent. I will write the street number and apartment number to match it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check the address your friend sent, including the street and apartment numbers. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 差出人の住所と名前も、宛先と区別できるよう記載してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also write the sender's address and name so they can be distinguished from the recipient's.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。友人の住所は表、自分の住所は裏に書きます。点字の部分にはテープを貼りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 宛先と差出人を区別し点字を覆わないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I will write my friend's address on the front and mine on the back. I will not put tape over the braille.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will distinguish recipient and sender and not cover the braille. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その状態で、文字の表示と封筒の閉じ方を確認します。料金区分は中身も含めて窓口で確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will check the printed information and how the envelope is sealed in that state. Let's confirm the postage category at the counter, including the contents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。表示を整えた封筒を持って戻り、内容と料金を確認してから出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 表示を整えた後に内容と料金を確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will come back with the properly labeled envelope and send it after checking the contents and postage.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will check the contents and postage after arranging the labeling. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 記入用のラベルはこちらです。点字を避けて貼れる位置をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12226-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here is a label to write on. Please find a position where you can attach it without covering the braille.
